title: malache scabra
intro: Malache scabra, commonly known as Malabar nut, is a plant species that belongs to the family Simaroubaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues, fever, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The health benefits of Malabar nut include its ability to treat constipation, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion due to its prebiotic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Malabar nut include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
